headline: Colonial Sweep Clears Linn of Mercy as Northern Sectors Grind On
war_summary: Since the previous dispatch, the central front has fractured decisively in Linn of Mercy, where Colonial forces overran remaining enemy garrisons to establish a commanding ten-base hold, leaving only a single neutral ruin after another five base actions along the Lathair and Outwich Ranch lines. To the east, Weathered Expanse continues to churn in furious deadlock, recording three fresh strategic shifts in the past two hours as Wardens defend their five strongholds against persistent probes around Wightwalk and Crow's Nest, keeping three contested bases demolished in no-man's-land. Across the northern perimeter, the violent see-saw in Nevish Line paused in base transfers over the last two hours, yet musketry and shellfire remain blistering with over two thousand casualties sustained. Simultaneously, Callahan's Passage has erupted into savage border fighting, claiming more than eighteen hundred casualties in two hours despite no recorded changes in base possession, while Marban Hollow maintains an uneasy partition of four Warden redoubts to three Colonial outposts.
